detail.readme:
# iii ![iii: point-to-point integrations vs zero-integration via shared runtime](.github/assets/zero-integration.png)

What is iii? · Install iii · Add Workers · SDKs · Agent Skills · Resources

## What is iii? iii is the easiest way to compose, observe, discover, extend, and react (CODER) to every service in your stack in real time. Every backend starts as a project before the first line of business logic. Queues, cron, HTTP, state, observability, agents, and sandboxes each usually bring their own integration story that complicates CODER. iii solves all of these concerns with one live system surface. ```bash iii compose --namespace dev --up iii call -n dev compose::add worker=queue iii call -n dev compose::add worker=agent iii call -n dev compose::add worker= ``` Each worker joins the live catalog. Every other worker is notified and can call it immediately. Browse available workers at [workers.iii.dev](https://workers.iii.dev/). That is the agent story too: when a task needs a capability the system does not have, an agent can add a worker, discover its functions, call them, and trace what happened. Same interface a developer uses. ### Three Primitives iii is powered by 3 primitives: **Workers** are processes that connect to the iii engine and register functions. A TypeScript API service is a worker. A Python data pipeline is a worker. A Rust microservice is a worker. Any functionality can be transformed into a worker with a few lines of code. Compose can also add workers at runtime, so agents and applications can extend the system while it is running. **Functions** are units of work with a stable identifier (e.g., `content::classify`, `orders::validate`). A function receives input, does work, and optionally returns output. Functions exist in workers, and any worker runs any function with `iii.call()`, wherever it is. **Observers** make the system reactive. `iii.observe('orders::create', 'alerts::big-order')` means: when `orders::create` runs, `alerts::big-order` runs. Every function can be observed, including the ones workers provide for events: an HTTP request is a call of `http::on-request`, a cron tick is a call of `cron::on-tick`, and a queue message is a call of `queue::on-message`. iii handles routing, serialization, and delivery. By mapping everything a service can do to these three primitives iii creates a development process that is both effortlessly composable, and completely observable. ## What Changes Before iii: - New observability tool: uncountable integrations - New agent harness: separate retry config, separate traces, separate timeouts - New queue: vendor evaluation, procurement, and weeks of integration After iii: - Declare workers in `worker-compose.yaml` - Run them with `iii compose --up` - Done. It is in the system, traceable, and callable. Platform teams publish workers. Application teams register functions and observe the functions they react to. Agents use the same catalog and the same function calls. Extending iii is adding a Compose worker. Composing iii is calling functions. Observing iii is opening the trace. ## Install iii Install `iii`: ```bash curl -fsSL https://install.iii.dev/iii/main/install.sh | sh ``` ## Add Workers Declare project workers in `worker-compose.yaml`, or add them through a running Compose daemon: ```bash iii call -n dev compose::add worker=queue ``` Browse packages at [workers.iii.dev](https://workers.iii.dev/) and see the [Compose documentation](https://iii.dev/docs/using-iii/compose). ## SDKs | Language | Package | Install | | -------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | | Node.js | [`iii-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/iii-sdk) | `pnpm add iii-sdk` or `npm install iii-sdk` | | Python | [`iii-sdk`](https://pypi.org/project/iii-sdk/) | `pip install iii-sdk` | | Rust | [`iii-sdk`](https://crates.io/crates/iii-sdk) | Add to `Cargo.toml` | | Go | [`iii-sdk`](sdk/packages/go/iii) | `go get github.com/iii-hq/iii/sdk/packages/go/iii` | ## Agent Skills for 3rd party harnesses If you're using the iii harness then agent skills are automatically available. If you're using another harness you can install iii's skills via: ```bash npx skills add iii-hq/iii/skills ``` These cover every iii primitive: HTTP endpoints, queues, cron, state, streams, observers, observable functions, and more. See [skills/](skills/) for the full list. Each worker in [iii-hq/workers](https://github.com/iii-hq/workers) also ships its own skill. Install them alongside the worker itself: ```bash npx skills add iii-hq/workers --list # list available worker skills npx skills add iii-hq/workers --skill database # one worker npx skills add iii-hq/workers --all # every worker skill ``` The engine-owned workers (`configuration`, `iii-worker-manager`, `iii-http-functions`, `iii-stream`, and `iii-sandbox`) and the automatically supplied engine functions, telemetry, and observability workers live in this repo. HTTP, cron, queue, state, pubsub, and bridge are standalone Compose workers. Install an engine skill with `npx skills add iii-hq/iii --full-depth --skill `; standalone workers ship their own skills in [iii-hq/workers](https://github.com/iii-hq/workers). ## Repository Structure | Directory | What it is | README | | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | | `engine/` | iii Engine (Rust) - core runtime, modules, and protocol | [engine/README.md](engine/README.md) | | `sdk/` | SDKs for Node.js, Python, Rust, and Go | [sdk/README.md](sdk/README.md) | | `skills/` | Agent-readable reference material | [skills/README.md](skills/README.md) | | `website/` | iii website | [website/](website/) | | `docs/` | Documentation site (Mintlify/MDX) | [docs/README.md](docs/README.md) | See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#how-dependencies-work) for workspace dependencies and [CI/CD details](CONTRIBUTING.md#cicd). ## Resources - [Documentation](https://iii.dev/docs) - [CLI & Engine](https://github.com/iii-hq/iii) - [Examples](https://github.com/iii-hq/iii-examples) - [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Star History

## License The iii is licensed as such: | Directory | License | | ---------- | ------------------------------------- | | `engine/` | [Elastic License 2.0](engine/LICENSE) | | `sdk/` | [Apache License 2.0](sdk/LICENSE) | | `docs/` | [Apache License 2.0](docs/LICENSE) | | `website/` | [Apache License 2.0](docs/LICENSE) | The engine runtime and the CLI are licensed under the Elastic License 2.0 (ELv2). All SDKs, documentation, and the website are licensed under the Apache License 2.0. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for additional details.
detail.readme_zh:
iii

> 本文件是 [README.md](README.md) 的简体中文翻译。为方便同步，正文中的代码、命令、专有名词（Worker、Function、Observer、Compose、SDK 等）保持原文。 ![iii: 从点对点集成到基于共享运行时的零集成](.github/assets/zero-integration.png)

什么是 iii？ · 安装 iii · 添加 Worker · SDK · Agent Skills · 资源

## 什么是 iii？ iii 是在实时场景中组合（compose）、观测（observe）、发现（discover）、扩展（extend）并响应（react）你技术栈中每一个服务的最简单方式，即 **CODER**。 每一个后端在写下第一行业务逻辑之前，都始于一个项目。队列、定时任务（cron）、HTTP、状态管理、可观测性、agent、沙箱（sandbox），往往各自都带来一套需要单独打通的集成方案，让 CODER 变得复杂。iii 用一个实时的系统界面（live system surface）统一解决了所有这些关注点。 ```bash iii compose --namespace dev --up iii call -n dev compose::add worker=queue iii call -n dev compose::add worker=agent iii call -n dev compose::add worker= ``` 每个 Worker 都会加入实时目录（live catalog）。其他所有 Worker 会立即收到通知并可以直接调用它。可在 [workers.iii.dev](https://workers.iii.dev/) 浏览可用的 Worker。 这也是关于 agent 的故事：当某个任务需要系统尚不具备的能力时，agent 可以添加一个 Worker、发现它的函数、调用它们，并追踪发生了什么。开发者与 agent 使用的是同一套接口。 ### 三大原语 iii 由 3 个原语驱动： **Workers** 是连接到 iii 引擎并注册 Functions 的进程。一个 TypeScript API 服务是一个 Worker，一个 Python 数据管道是一个 Worker，一个 Rust 微服务也是一个 Worker。只需几行代码，任何功能都可以被改造为一个 Worker。Compose 还能在运行时添加 Worker，因此 agent 和应用可以在系统运行的过程中对其扩展。 **Functions** 是具有稳定标识符的工作单元（例如 `content::classify`、`orders::validate`）。Function 接收输入、执行工作，并可选择性地返回输出。Functions 存在于 Worker 之中，任何 Worker 都可以用 `iii.call()` 调用任何 Function，无论它运行在哪里。 **Observers** 让系统具备响应能力。`iii.observe('orders::create', 'alerts::big-order')` 的含义是：当 `orders::create` 运行时，`alerts::big-order` 随之运行。每一个 Function 都可以被观测（observe），包括 Worker 为事件提供的 Function：一个 HTTP 请求是对 `http::on-request` 的一次调用，cron 的一次 tick 是对 `cron::on-tick` 的一次调用，一条队列消息是对 `queue::on-message` 的一次调用。iii 负责路由、序列化和投递。 通过将服务所能做的一切映射到这三个原语，iii 打造出一个既毫不费力地可组合、又完全可观测的开发流程。 ## 带来什么改变 在使用 iii 之前： - 新的可观测性工具：数不尽的集成工作 - 新的 agent harness：单独的重试配置、单独的链路追踪、单独的超时 - 新的队列：厂商评估、采购，以及数周的集成 在使用 iii 之后： - 在 `worker-compose.yaml` 中声明 Worker - 用 `iii compose --up` 运行它们 - 完成。它已进入系统，可被追踪、可被调用。 平台团队发布 Worker，应用团队注册函数并观测（observe）它们要响应的函数，agent 使用同一份目录、同一套函数调用。 扩展 iii 就是添加一个 Compose Worker；编排 iii 就是调用函数；观测 iii 就是打开那条链路追踪（trace）。 ## 安装 iii 安装 `iii`： ```bash curl -fsSL https://install.iii.dev/iii/main/install.sh | sh ``` ## 添加 Worker 在 `worker-compose.yaml` 中声明项目的 Worker，或通过一个正在运行的 Compose 守护进程添加它们： ```bash iii call -n dev compose::add worker=queue ``` 在 [workers.iii.dev](https://workers.iii.dev/) 浏览软件包，并查阅 [Compose 文档](https://iii.dev/docs/using-iii/compose)。 ## SDK | 语言 | 软件包 | 安装 | | -------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | | Node.js | [`iii-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/iii-sdk) | `pnpm add iii-sdk` 或 `npm install iii-sdk` | | Python | [`iii-sdk`](https://pypi.org/project/iii-sdk/) | `pip install iii-sdk` | | Rust | [`iii-sdk`](https://crates.io/crates/iii-sdk) | 添加到 `Cargo.toml` | | Go | [`iii-sdk`](sdk/packages/go/iii) | `go get github.com/iii-hq/iii/sdk/packages/go/iii` | ## 面向第三方 harness 的 Agent Skills 如果你使用的是 iii harness，那么 agent skills 会自动可用。 如果你使用的是其他 harness，可以通过以下方式安装 iii 的 skills： ```bash npx skills add iii-hq/iii/skills ``` 这些 skills 覆盖了 iii 的每一个原语：HTTP 端点、队列、cron、状态、流、Observer、可观测函数（observable function）等等。完整列表见 [skills/](skills/)。 [iii-hq/workers](https://github.com/iii-hq/workers) 中的每个 Worker 也自带各自的 skill。可与 Worker 一起安装： ```bash npx skills add iii-hq/workers --list # 列出可用的 worker skills npx skills add iii-hq/workers --skill database # 单个 worker npx skills add iii-hq/workers --all # 所有 worker skill ``` 引擎自带的 Worker（`configuration`、`iii-worker-manager`、`iii-http-functions`、`iii-stream` 和 `iii-sandbox`），以及由引擎自动提供的函数、遥测与可观测性 Worker，都在本仓库中。HTTP、cron、队列、状态、pubsub 和 bridge 则是独立的 Compose Worker。使用 `npx skills add iii-hq/iii --full-depth --skill ` 安装某个引擎 skill；独立 Worker 会在 [iii-hq/workers](https://github.com/iii-hq/workers) 中随自身分发各自的 skills。 ## 仓库结构 | 目录 | 说明 | README | | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | | `engine/` | iii 引擎（Rust）——核心运行时、模块与协议 | [engine/README.md](engine/README.md) | | `sdk/` | 面向 Node.js、Python、Rust 与 Go 的 SDK | [sdk/README.md](sdk/README.md) | | `skills/` | 供 agent 阅读的参考材料 | [skills/README.md](skills/README.md) | | `website/` | iii 官网 | [website/](website/) | | `docs/` | 文档站点（Mintlify/MDX） | [docs/README.md](docs/README.md) | 工作区依赖关系见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#how-dependencies-work)，持续集成与发布流程见 [CI/CD](CONTRIBUTING.md#cicd)。 ## 资源 - [文档](https://iii.dev/docs) - [CLI 与引擎](https://github.com/iii-hq/iii) - [示例](https://github.com/iii-hq/iii-examples) - [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Star 趋势

## 许可证 iii 按如下方式授权： | 目录 | 许可证 | | ---------- | ------------------------------------- | | `engine/` | [Elastic License 2.0](engine/LICENSE) | | `sdk/` | [Apache License 2.0](sdk/LICENSE) | | `docs/` | [Apache License 2.0](docs/LICENSE) | | `website/` | [Apache License 2.0](docs/LICENSE) | 引擎运行时和 CLI 采用 Elastic License 2.0（ELv2）授权。所有 SDK、文档以及官网均采用 Apache License 2.0 授权。 更多细节见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。
